component.name: AppTile
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.body = m.top.createChild("Group") m.body.scaleRotateCenter = [th.tileW / 2, th.tileH / 2]
m.glow = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.glow.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/focus_glow_tile.png" m.glow.translation = [-120, -120] m.glow.width = 528 m.glow.height = 432 m.glow.opacity = 0
m.shadow = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.shadow.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/tile_shadow.png" m.shadow.translation = [-60, -52] m.shadow.width = 408 m.shadow.height = 332
' Real apps: the logo, background removed by the bridge, sits straight on a painted card. m.card = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.card.width = th.tileW m.card.height = th.tileH
' Window fill for Lumen tiles, the app icon for real apps (spec 5.3: 208x156 at +40,+18). m.fill = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.fill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/card_r28.9.png" m.fill.blendColor = th.paper m.fill.translation = [40, 18] m.fill.width = 208 m.fill.height = 156 m.fill.visible = false
' The bridge sends logos on a transparent 288x192 canvas, so they cover the whole card. m.icon = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.icon.width = th.tileW m.icon.height = th.tileH m.icon.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit"
' Memories: two full-card photos (rounded by the bridge), crossfading like a slideshow. m.photoA = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.photoB = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.photoA.id = "photoA" m.photoB.id = "photoB" for each p in [m.photoA, m.photoB] p.width = th.tileW p.height = th.tileH p.opacity = 0 end for
' Memories with no photos yet: an italic wordmark under the picture glyph. m.word = m.body.createChild("Label") m.word.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Italic", 30) m.word.color = th.ink m.word.horizAlign = "center" m.word.translation = [0, 118] m.word.width = th.tileW m.word.height = 40 m.word.visible = false
m.glyph = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.glyph.translation = [112, 64] m.glyph.width = 64 m.glyph.height = 64 m.glyph.blendColor = th.ink m.glyph.visible = false
m.frame = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.frame.width = th.tileW m.frame.height = th.tileH
m.ring = m.body.createChild("Poster") m.ring.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/focus_ring_tile.png" m.ring.translation = [-8, -8] m.ring.width = 304 m.ring.height = 208 m.ring.opacity = 0
buildAnims() end sub
sub buildAnims() ' Roku has no outBack easing: the overshoot is written into the keys (PLAN 6.1). m.focusIn = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.focusIn.duration = 0.22 m.focusIn.easeFunction = "outCubic" m.inScale = m.focusIn.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.inScale.fieldToInterp = "body.scale" m.inScale.key = [0, 0.6, 1] m.inScale.keyValue = [[1, 1], [1.13, 1.13], [1.1, 1.1]] m.inPos = m.focusIn.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.inPos.fieldToInterp = "body.translation" m.inPos.key = [0, 1] m.inPos.keyValue = [[0, 0], [0, -10]] m.inRing = m.focusIn.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.inRing.fieldToInterp = "ring.opacity" m.inRing.key = [0, 1] m.inRing.keyValue = [0, 1] m.inGlow = m.focusIn.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.inGlow.fieldToInterp = "glow.opacity" m.inGlow.key = [0, 1] m.inGlow.keyValue = [0, 1]
m.focusOut = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.focusOut.duration = 0.16 m.focusOut.easeFunction = "outCubic" m.outScale = m.focusOut.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.outScale.fieldToInterp = "body.scale" m.outScale.key = [0, 1] m.outScale.keyValue = [[1.1, 1.1], [1, 1]] m.outPos = m.focusOut.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.outPos.fieldToInterp = "body.translation" m.outPos.key = [0, 1] m.outPos.keyValue = [[0, -10], [0, 0]] m.outRing = m.focusOut.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.outRing.fieldToInterp = "ring.opacity" m.outRing.key = [0, 1] m.outRing.keyValue = [1, 0] m.outGlow = m.focusOut.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.outGlow.fieldToInterp = "glow.opacity" m.outGlow.key = [0, 1] m.outGlow.keyValue = [1, 0]
' Spec 11: x0.96 over 100ms, back over 120ms with overshoot. m.press = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.press.duration = 0.22 m.press.easeFunction = "linear" m.pressScale = m.press.createChild("Vector2DFieldInterpolator") m.pressScale.fieldToInterp = "body.scale" m.pressScale.key = [0, 0.45, 0.8, 1] m.pressScale.keyValue = [[1.1, 1.1], [1.056, 1.056], [1.12, 1.12], [1.1, 1.1]]
' Interpolators address children by id. m.body.id = "body" m.ring.id = "ring" m.glow.id = "glow" end sub
sub onApp() a = m.top.app if a = invalid then return if a.id = "lumen.memories" ' Same painted card as the apps: picture glyph + "Memories" until photos arrive. m.card.uri = "pkg:/images/tiles/card_" + PastelFor(a.id) + ".png" m.frame.visible = false m.glyph.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/ic_picture.png" m.glyph.width = 76 m.glyph.height = 76 m.glyph.translation = [106, 36] m.glyph.visible = true m.word.text = "Memories" m.word.visible = true m.icon.visible = false else if a.id = "lumen.add" ' Same painted card as the apps, with an ink plus at the 92px glyph size (spec 5.2). m.card.uri = "pkg:/images/tiles/card_cream.png" m.frame.visible = false m.glyph.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/ic_plus.png" m.glyph.width = 92 m.glyph.height = 92 m.glyph.translation = [98, 50] m.glyph.visible = true m.icon.visible = false else m.card.uri = "pkg:/images/tiles/card_" + PastelFor(a.id) + ".png" m.frame.visible = false m.icon.uri = m.top.iconBase + "/query/icon/" + a.id ' Fallback (spec 5.2): if the ECP icon fails, show a Lumen glyph tile instead. m.icon.failedBitmapUri = "pkg:/images/tiles/tile_video.png" end if end sub
sub onPhotos() list = m.top.photos if list = invalid or list.Count() = 0 then return m.glyph.visible = false m.word.visible = false m.photoIndex = -1 m.front = m.photoB if m.cycle = invalid m.cycle = m.top.createChild("Timer") m.cycle.duration = 6 m.cycle.repeat = true m.cycle.observeField("fire", "nextPhoto") m.fade = m.top.createChild("Animation") m.fade.duration = 0.8 m.fade.easeFunction = "inOutCubic" m.fadeIn = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeIn.key = [0, 1] m.fadeIn.keyValue = [0, 1] m.fadeOut = m.fade.createChild("FloatFieldInterpolator") m.fadeOut.key = [0, 1] m.fadeOut.keyValue = [1, 0] end if nextPhoto() if list.Count() > 1 then m.cycle.control = "start" end sub
sub nextPhoto() list = m.top.photos m.photoIndex = (m.photoIndex + 1) mod list.Count() if m.front.isSameNode(m.photoA) then back = m.photoB else back = m.photoA back.uri = list[m.photoIndex] + "?card=1" m.fadeIn.fieldToInterp = back.id + ".opacity" m.fadeOut.fieldToInterp = m.front.id + ".opacity" m.fade.control = "start" m.front = back end sub
sub placeX() m.top.translation = [m.top.baseX, 0] end sub
sub onFocus() if m.top.reduceMotion s = 1.0 if m.top.focused then s = 1.1 m.body.scale = [s, s] o = 0.0 if m.top.focused then o = 1.0 m.ring.opacity = o m.glow.opacity = o return end if if m.top.focused m.focusOut.control = "stop" m.focusIn.control = "start" else m.focusIn.control = "stop" m.focusOut.control = "start" end if end sub
sub onLifted() m.focusIn.control = "stop" m.focusOut.control = "stop" if m.top.lifted m.body.scale = [1.16, 1.16] m.body.translation = [0, -22] m.ring.opacity = 1 m.glow.opacity = 1 else m.body.scale = [1.1, 1.1] m.body.translation = [0, -10] end if end sub
sub onPress() if not m.top.reduceMotion then m.press.control = "start" end sub
